record.issue_text: Pagination logic totalPages = Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 yields an extra empty page when user_count % limit == 0

adjudication.rationale: `totalPages` in `admin-group.js.es6` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (when `user_count != 0`). If `user_count` is exactly divisible by `limit` (e.g., 100 users with limit 50), this returns 3 instead of 2, creating an extra empty page. This is exacerbated by `actions.next`, which can set `offset` to `user_count` (`Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`), and `findMembers` will then request `offset=user_count`, yielding an empty member list while `currentPage/totalPages` show the extra page.
